title: 2-Bit Ripple-Carry Adder
description: A half adder for bit 0 and a full adder for bit 1; the carry ripples from one to the next.

education.summary: Adding binary numbers bit by bit: each stage adds two bits plus the carry from the stage before it.
objectives: Trace a carry through two stages
Explain why the first stage needs no carry input
Predict the sum for any pair of 2-bit inputs
questions: What is 11 + 01 in binary, and which output bits go high?
How many gate delays does the carry take to cross n stages?
